amendment_1.identity_2: With narrowed_any set inside the narrowing block (before vt0 is formed), the recurrence is used at iteration i only if no iteration 0..i narrowed. Then V_j = V_{j,full} for every j <= i, so V_a^T M V_b = V_{a+1}^T M V_{b-1} = ... = 0 for all a < b <= i (each chain step uses an unnarrowed V_{a+1}), in particular V_{i-1}^T M V_0 = 0 and v0 = V_0; and sel_used is the identity. So V_i^T V_0 = -c1^T (V_{i-1}^T V0) - c2^T (V_{i-2}^T V0) exactly, in every path. Once set, the flag stays set and the direct gram is used for the rest of the call. The guard is conservative: it also uses the direct gram in the narrowing iteration itself, where the recurrence was still exact; that is the whole BLR1 - BLR difference.
amendment_1.stress: 0 inexact uses of identity 2 (was 19,631 in 1,922 calls), 0 of identity 1, 0 REF/BLR1 differences in kernel vector, iterations or narrowing in all 20,000 trials incl. the 2,990 mid-run narrowings (was 24 kernel differences); count reconciliation exact in all 19,842 audited calls (was 18,813)
amendment_1.reconciliation: REF - BLR1 = skipped grams - recurrence exactly in 34 audited runs
amendment_1.blr1_vs_blr: 23/23 narrowing cells differ, only in DL linear_algebra lmul/ladd (+3352..13800 lmul, max rel 4.06e-04); 0/7 unnarrowed cells differ; largest ratio change 0.00021

discrepancies.severity: substantive for the mathematical claim; no effect on any measured number
discrepancies.what: Identity 2 is not an exact identity of this implementation. Its derivation needs V_{i-1}^T M V_0 = 0, which holds unconditionally only for i <= 3; for i >= 4 it needs long-range M-orthogonality, which a narrowing at an iteration j >= 1 that drops columns can destroy for later iterations. The guard (!narrowed0) excludes only narrowing at iteration 0. PROTOCOL.md H_blr ('as V_{i-1}^T M V_0 = 0') and README ('direct grams otherwise') state it as exact.
discrepancies.evidence: stress harness, 20,000 block_lanczos calls: 2990 calls narrowed before their final iteration (all at ell <= 101; none at ell = 65537 or 4.5e15); in 1922 of them identity 2 was inexact at one or more iterations (19631 inexact uses), and in 24 the kernel vector BLR returned differs from REF's (examples in the replay certificate; all 24 in replay/.../stress/divergent-trials.jsonl). Zero inexact uses in the calls without narrowing, with narrowing at iteration 0 (fallback), or with narrowing only in the final iteration or the terminating check.
discrepancies.scope_effect: None on this study: in all 30 producer cells and all replayed configurations the oracle found 0 inexact uses of either identity; narrowing occurs only in the final iteration, so no reuse follows a narrowing (id2_reuse_after_a_narrowing = 0). A guard that disables identity 2 in every iteration after any narrowing would give the same counts on every measured cell.
discrepancies.required_correction: Before BLR is cited as exact or reused outside k = 18..22 of this family (other ell, block widths, matrices that narrow mid-run): disable the V_i^T V_0 recurrence after any narrowing (not only at iteration 0), and state identity 2 as conditional in README/PROTOCOL successors. Identity 1 needs no change.
discrepancies.resolution: amendment-1 (98a4fc6639, data 69e368d44b): the guard is narrowed_any, set on every narrowing before vt0 is formed, so identity 2 is used only while no iteration has narrowed, where it is exact (proof in the replay certificate, amendment_1.identity_2_after_guard). Stress harness on the amended la2.rs: 0 inexact uses in 80,955, 0 kernel/iteration/narrowing differences from REF in 20,000 trials incl. all 2,990 mid-run narrowings. The study's numbers are now BLR1's: they differ from the frozen BLR only in DL linear_algebra lmul/ladd of the 23 narrowing cells (+3,352..13,800 lmul, <= 0.041%), largest ratio change 0.00021; the headline below is BLR1's.

discrepancies.what: The identity-1 fallback condition vpr.k == k_full is always true (V_full has k_{i-1} columns by construction), so gram(mvpr, mv) is dead code; 'when the dimensions match' in PROTOCOL.md is vacuous. Identity 1 is exact in every path (proof in the replay certificate; 142,892 stress uses and every real-run use, 0 mismatches).

The prediction window (0.80-0.84 / 0.87-0.90) was written after a pilot on seed 1 at k = 18, 20, 22, so it is not independent of 3 of the 30 cells; the linear-algebra lmul prediction (0.75-0.80) missed (0.729-0.738), as README reports.

discrepancies.severity: record consistency; no effect on the validated numbers
discrepancies.what: VALIDATION.json in both directories (a1e16d39e4) predates the amendment results: (a) its sha256 pins name the round-1 report/certificate and no longer match the amended files; (b) binary_or_process says the amendment-1 guarded build is 'identical in every counted field on all 30 units', which RESULT.md and this validation contradict (23 cells differ in DL linear_algebra lmul/ladd); (c) gae_band ic holds the frozen-BLR k = 22 means (843987004.8361, 1013984140.2361, 2543958358.8361) while the amended study's IC side is BLR1's (844014769.0561, 1014011904.4561, 2543986123.0561; relative change 3.3e-5, 2.7e-5, 1.1e-5). The validator did not edit VALIDATION.json (outside this task); it needs the new pins, the BLR1 binary (e236855d...) and the BLR1 band values.

null_object_control: The claim is a deterministic counted-work ratio, not a statistical signal. Nulls of the same shape: (a) REF replay = committed REF = fasthash COMBO bit for bit (A/A on counted fields, ratio exactly 1); (b) the untouched D and DL1 arms give BLR/REF exactly 1.000 at every cell and w; (c) negative controls: MUT_C2 and MUT_PM, each on 2 configurations, are flagged by the same comparator (LA fails, 6 DL attempts), so G1-style equality has power against an inexact reuse. Mechanism check in place of a decay parameter: the saving should shrink as the block width falls (the removed products are n k^2 and n k b per iteration vs the sparse matvec) and does: DL ratio at w_add 0 = 0.909, 0.861, 0.833, 0.815 at b = 1, 2, 3, 4 (q = 1048507) and 0.774 at b = 8 (q = 524287); LA lmul ratio 0.770, 0.745, 0.737, 0.732, 0.728 toward the dense-only limit 5/7.

validation_ladder_checks.step1_assumptions_isolated: the claim rests on M-orthogonality (identity 1: distance 1 and 2; identity 2: to V_0 at every distance). Measured separately per iteration by the oracle build on all 30 cells, and stressed at small ell where narrowing is frequent; failure mode hunted: an inexact reuse that leaves counts equal or changes the solution. Found for identity 2 after mid-run narrowing only (D1).
validation_ladder_checks.step2_measured_ratio_on_full_pipeline: the ratio is measured on the full pipeline against REF at every size claimed (k = 18..22, 30 cells), re-measured on new seeds (9, 10) and other block widths; predicted negative cases (D, DL1 = 1) checked. No extrapolation beyond k = 22 is claimed.

limitations: L0: session container (4 vCPU), units up to 3 concurrent; only counted fields are claimed and compared. No EKS route, no native L2/replay/A/A admission.

Scope: GHS-weak family E0/F_{q^3}, driver ic <q> <seed> D 3.0 1.7, k = 18..22, seeds 1-6 (producer) plus seeds 9 and 10 and block widths 1, 2, 3, 8 (replay). Identity 2 is exact on these instances (oracle) but not in general (D1).

The rho side is the frozen negation-map band of research/quartic_dl1_cd_sqrt_20261113/combo/validation/VALIDATION.json; this validation re-measured no rho. The band prices additions at 0; at w_add = 1 the IC side is larger (ratios 0.88-0.89).

Independence: subagent of the producer's session on the same container; own scripts and builds; analyze.py and plot.py not read.

A passed report means the receipt is admissible evidence for the counted-cost numbers at k = 18..22 in this family. It does not support an ECDLP claim, demonstrate an asymptotic speedup, or authorize promotion; the leaderboard row additionally needs VALIDATION.json with the matched rho reference.
